text: August's billing cycle is the real test of everything built so far. Priya Shah's Billing team and Renata Vance's Member Services team sit down to see the corrected numbers -- and hear exactly what almost went wrong.
INST-04821 computed at 1,842.6 kilowatt-hours for August -- nearly double its own twelve-month history. The cause: 79 duplicate rows from a Kinesis retry the old dedup key never caught.
Projected live: 9,003 raw rows, only 8,924 true unique events. Same event ID, timestamps a few hundred milliseconds apart -- the signature of a resend.
At the co-op's rate, that bug would have meant $207.29 instead of $104.78. But it was caught before the billing run finalized -- zero member statements went out wrong.
The numbers are trusted again. Next: writing down what all of this means, and where it lives, so the next engineer on call isn't starting from zero.
